title: Pan's Labyrinth (bc30)
synopsis: 1944. Rural Spain. As Franco consolidates his brutal hold after years of civil war, lonely and dreamy Ofelia must come to terms with the cruelty around her. Living with her tyrannical stepfather in a new home with her pregnant mother, Ofelia feels alone until she explores a decaying labyrinth guarded by a mysterious faun who claims to know her destiny. If she wishes to return to her real father, Ofelia must complete three terrifying tasks.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1944年，西班牙正處於內戰，整個國家受到法西斯獨裁者的高壓陰霾所籠罩。 12歲小女孩奧菲莉亞於二戰期間，隨父母往森林避戰，卻誤闖進森林內的巨石迷宮，遇見羊頭人身的牧神。牧神說其實她是傳說中地下王國的公主。如果奧菲莉亞想重返本來屬於她的地下世界，她必須完成三項艱鉅而危險的任務……
